change: CHG-256 — Certify StockLedger personal-use perfection handoff readiness
selected_handoff_scope: Single-owner personal local-first/web-first StockLedger for US equities and ETFs using completed daily bars; no automatic trading, custody, return guarantee, or guaranteed maximum-profit claim.

decisive_facts: Source-bound release evidence was generated and verified against the explicit protected base equal to the unchanged source commit.
No prior individual Change GO is treated as Project handoff readiness.
Preview, workspace and worker evaluation share the versioned dated engine; engine 2.1.0 and financial_truth_v1.
Results preserve TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN, exact evaluation time, gates, risk, warmups, units and benchmark/date alignment.
Missing or quality-blocked inputs cannot establish a confident setup.
Provenance keeps source/origin, observed session, retrieval time, adjustment basis, dataset identity and optional provider/rights/content/coverage details.
Stale, partial, unavailable, malformed, rights-blocked and failed evidence remains non-clean and cannot silently produce a trusted signal.
No source or legal authority was fabricated.
Recipe revision publication creates a new version with stable condition lineage while preserving the prior recipe.
Evaluation history is content-addressed by evidence revision; alert and decision context retains the recipe version and condition evidence.
Decision amendments and outcome notes are retained and exported.
Worker persists jobs, alerts and evaluations in separate SQLite and writes a complete StockLedger JSON export.
Web app persists its workspace in IndexedDB and displays imported last-known worker state; it does not observe or subscribe to worker output.
Runbook requires manual worker-export-to-app import and reverse app-export-to-worker replacement with matching worker revision, paused scheduled writers and before-import SQLite copy.
Consequently scheduled worker changes do not reach Today/Alerts/Journal when the owner opens the app; repeated whole-workspace shuttling materially weakens the review-when-it-matters workflow.
A supported local path exists for Date,Open,High,Low,Close,Volume histories; worker files use TICKER.csv and adjustment basis is explicitly declared adjusted, unadjusted or unknown.
Complete consecutive NYSE sessions and exact benchmark histories are validated; long metrics require full warmup.
Fabric has no real owner watchlist, authorized CSV directory or provider provenance; these are owner inputs.
Invoked Node/SQLite worker operates independently of Expo UI with durable leases, retries, atomic commits, semantic idempotency, corrected-input reconciliation, bounded admission and catch-up.
Owner must install/monitor launchd or cron on an awake machine with an authorized CSV path; schedulerInstalled remains false until then.
Synthetic status reported stopped/unconfigured with requiresAwakeMachine=true; no owner hardware or schedule was fabricated.
Alert creation, durable intent, transport submission and receipt are distinct.
SMTP 250 remains provider-accepted/ambiguous; delivered requires a transport-specific confirmed receipt.
Preferences, quiet hours, digest, snooze, cancellation, retry, leases, ambiguity and safe last-known status are durably represented.
In-app Today covers its loaded workspace; background worker visibility is R5.
SMTP is optional, server-only and absent from client bundles; in-app review needs no external channel.
If email is selected, destination, consent, awake invocation and private SMTP endpoint/credentials are owner config.
No external delivery or OS push was claimed.
Validated schema-versioned complete workspace import/export, IndexedDB revision-checked writes and previous-copy recovery are implemented.
Worker SQLite migrations are additive; consistent backups and isolated restore preserve authored history, evaluations, decisions, jobs, ingestion and notification state.
Synthetic recovery drill passed; real owner data and backup cadence remain external.
Safe status covers missed/partial/blocked/retrying/terminal coverage, worker/database/ingestion/notification state, release identity and bounded measurements.
Same-source release:evidence and release:verify passed; equal explicit base/source satisfies checked ancestry.
Rollback assertions allow compatible static artifacts or same-schema restore, not schema downgrade.
Synthetic operations qualification is not an SLA or real-owner restore.
Current tree equals accepted Golden UI v3 tree, whose bounded web authority includes zoom/reflow, focus restoration, geometry/action reachability and task oracles.
Current-source browser rerun passed 87 cases; the only skip is the intentional mobile hardware-keyboard case.
Native physical-device/store requirements are outside this web/desktop profile.
App and worker share domain evaluation/contracts; client/server boundary check passes.
The data-shuttle issue is an owner-facing integration gap, not an architecture-aesthetics objection.
Private research memory and monitoring for US equities/ETFs on completed daily bars, with human decisions; no trading, custody or performance guarantee.
Broad scanning is optional discovery; watchlist monitoring does not require scanner expansion.
Stooq is explicitly on-demand/research-only and unverified adjustment/authority does not qualify managed trusted ingestion.
It is not required by user-supplied adjusted CSV monitoring.
Paid/public/native/multi-user/hosted/commercial, teams/marketplace and broad scanner/backtest expansion are outside the local personal handoff.

material_gaps.title: Scheduled worker changes do not reach app review without repeated whole-workspace handoffs
material_gaps.root_cause: Worker SQLite WAL and web IndexedDB are independent durable workspaces; the bridge is full backup file import/export with no app-visible ready/update handoff or incremental conflict-safe reconciliation.
material_gaps.owner_consequence: After app-closed scheduled evaluation, Today/Alerts/Journal remain stale until owner finds and manually imports worker export. Reverse app-to-worker import also requires a matching revision, paused schedule and before-import copy. This materially burdens routine review.
